title:
Comment of Jess Repko in Docket(s)/Project(s) P-15423-000
Submission Date: 11/2/2026

documents.name: 152136.txt
documents.text:
Jess Repko, Anchorage, AK.
To whom it may concern, 

The way this data center is being proposed and placed is absolutely unacceptable and illegal. There has been no formal vote, no proper zoning and no research showing the impact on our environment and ecosystem. This is dark money at its finest and we as a community deserve better and should not have to suffer for deepening pockets. Shame on our government for failing us and falling into this trap that has the potential to ruin lives and completely destroy Alaskas precious environment. This whole situation needs to go through the steps that any new infrastructure does and the people of Alaska deserve a fair vote and say. AI does not need to continue at the rate it is going. We the people deserve a say and to be allowed to stop the development of these devastating machines. Give us our right to vote.
